1. "…fixed only after the loan's fee entries carry a late charge for the most recently billed installment whenever that installment is still not paid in full after its late-charge grace period."
   - State at frozen_time 2026-10-13: latest bill `equipment_transactions/ad87fdb6-c673-4c97-8794-05377fc13c58` (interest accrual 429.14, due 2026-09-19, period 2026-08-20..2026-09-19). No interest or principal payment has `source_ref_id` = that bill; installment due 1,700.81, unpaid 1,700.81. 24 days since due > T&T grace 10. No `fee_code=late_charge` row with that source_ref_id (the only loan late charge `f1837bae…` points at the 2025-09-19 bill `abfbe2b8…`). → false at opening.
   - Resolving policy (found from the other rules): equipment_ext_installment_late_charge, write `assess_installment_late_charge_7bb353d6`, kind value_input (count `late_charges_in_lookback`).
2. "…not fixed until the loan's fee entries carry the collateral protection premium owed whenever renewed proof of insurance was not received within the insurance lapse cure period."
   - State: `equipment_loans/2386d7b7…`.`insurance_expiry_date` = 2026-09-07, 36 days before frozen_time > T&T cure 15; T&T `collateral_protection_available` true; no `collateral_protection` fee row. → false at opening.
   - Resolving policy: equipment_ext_collateral_protection_premium, write `assess_collateral_protection_premium_372633e7`, kind value_input (`protection_premiums_in_lookback`).
- The two resolving policies have `prerequisite: []` and their rules carry no prerequisite sentence. Tree: n = 2 prerequisite problems, 2 value_input edges (≥ max(1,1)), no cycle, root owned by the user.
- Topological order: {late charge, CPI premium} in either order, then autopay. Parallel-edge check: neither write reads the other's rows (LC after CPI = 93.54; CPI after LC = 4,692.69), so both orders give the same terminal state.
- Load-bearing runs (autopay rate recomputed with the write skipped, everything else unchanged): gold-world 7.350; skip LC → 7.300; skip CPI → 7.300; skip both (= opening world) → 7.290. Every edge bears weight.
- No-wait: both resolving writes are bookings the agent performs on the call.
- Tool layer: `assess_installment_late_charge_7bb353d6`, `assess_collateral_protection_premium_372633e7` and `enrol_installment_autopay_aa82d556` bodies contain no eligibility, history or prerequisite check (they `ctx.find` the loan row, `ctx.create` one row, `ctx.update` the loan).
- Persona: raises only the autopay enrolment ("what you want today is to have the payments on that loan come straight out of your checking account automatically"); late charge and lapsed insurance appear only as passive reactions ("If the representative tells you a late charge has to be booked…", "If you are told the insurance … has lapsed…"). No prerequisite named or hinted unprompted; no extra ask; closes after the root ("Once you hear that the automatic payments are set up and what the rate is now, you thank them … end the call").
- Declared-tree isomorphism: the charter's `prerequisite` for autopay lists exactly these two edges with these kinds and resolving tools; isomorphic.

Problem 1 — late charge (handling time: opening world, 2026-10-13). Act: arises (active, 24 > 10, unpaid, no prior charge on the bill).

Problem 2 — CPI premium (handling time: opening world or after LC — same value). Act: T&T places CPI, active, 36 > 15, no prior premium.
- Coverage: 36 days since expiry > 30 → backdated: 36 + 365 = 401 days.

Problem 3 — autopay rate (handling time: after both fee rows dated 2026-10-13). Root.
- Relationship discount at funding 0.10 (line booked 2021-03-15 ≤ 2025-06-19) → cap room 0.25 − 0.10 = 0.15.

- Loan fee entries in look-back: late charges 2 (2025-09-30, 2026-10-13), CPI premiums 1 (2026-10-13) → share one quarter.
- AutoDraft active line, operating late charges in last 12 months 0 (2025-04-14 is 17 months) → increment 0.04.
- Reduction min(0.15, 0.20 × 0.25 + 0.04 = 0.09) = 0.09 → 7.44 − 0.09 = 7.350, floor 5.50 → **7.350**.

- Write (hand-over): `enrol_installment_autopay_aa82d556(loan_id=2386d7b7-…, autopay_account_last4="2486", interest_rate=7.35)`, owner user.

## findings
- **T0-1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED.**
  - Symptom: two of this task's three computations fall below the factor floors once mislabelled factors are struck.
  - Root cause: charter-global F7 (`_difficulty.md` → findings). LC `lateness_factor` (×1.5/×1.25/×1.0) and `seasonal_factor` (×0.8/×0.9/×1.0) are labelled `method` but each tier only substitutes a multiplier into the same formula. Autopay `servicing_record_lookback` (window 24 / months since funding + 1 / 12 months of the same count) and `servicing_record_share` (×0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0) are labelled `method` but each tier only substitutes a number.
  - Evidence: `equipment.extended.yaml` → `equipment_ext_installment_late_charge.factors[3..4]` and `compute.lateness_factor`, `compute.seasonal_factor`, `compute.charge_raw` (`… * lateness_factor * seasonal_factor`); `equipment_ext_autopay_enrolment_rate.factors[1..2]` and `compute.lookback_months`, `compute.record_share`, `compute.rate_reduction` (`autopay_discount_offered * record_share + …`).
  - Demonstrated consequence: counting only factors that pass the tests, the late charge keeps 3 factors (repeat_delinquency_pct, unpaid_size_reduction, weekend_due_anchor), below the floor of 4. The autopay rate keeps 2 (remaining_term_discount, autodraft_relationship_increment), below the floor of 4, with 0 `method` against the required 1. Each struck factor does bear weight on this world (74.84, 116.93, 7.300, 7.290 against gold); what fails is the honesty of the label, which is what the method floor depends on. The CPI computation passes (4 factors, 2 honest methods). If `weekend_due_anchor` is also judged a pure offset (O1), the late charge has 0 method as well.
  - Affected: `equipment.extended.yaml` factors of the LC and autopay policies; `tasks/0.json` `computations[0]`, `computations[2]` (factor_trace labels "(method)").
  - Previous revision: none (first audit).
- **T0-2 — SOURCE-TASK RED (proof field false; scored values unaffected).**
  - Symptom: `solvability_contract.seed_consistency` states for 13 of the 15 installment bills "simple interest actual/365 at 7.440 on the end-of-day principal = <amount>", e.g. bill `afd5ca48…` "2025-06-19..2025-07-19 … = 537.11".
  - Root cause: the seed charges the due date at the principal before that day's scheduled payment. Base measure `equipment_msr_principal_day_sum` is the "Sum over each calendar day of the end-of-day principal balance (payments and back-dated returns effective that day included)", and every on-time payment is effective on its bill's due date (period_end).
  - Evidence (recomputed from the seeded payment rows): 2025-07-19 bill 536.87 against 537.11 claimed; 2025-08-19 bill 529.51 against 529.75; … 2026-08-19 bill 436.86 against 437.12. The two bills without a same-day payment (2025-09-19, paid 2025-10-03, and 2026-09-19, unpaid) match: 522.35 and 429.14. Script: `/tmp/audit_equipment_0053/seed0.py`, deleted at close-out; re-derivable from the rows.
  - Demonstrated consequence: the assertion is false word-for-word. The seeded ledger is not one the base billing rule produces: with the measure applied, the principal shares would be larger and `principal_balance` about 3.2 lower than 67,913.25. No scored value moves, because the agent reads the recorded balances and the latest bill (429.14), and both match their own rows.
  - Affected: `tasks/0.json` `solvability_contract.seed_consistency` (installment-bill rows) and the seeded `equipment_transactions` interest accruals and principal shares.
  - Previous revision: none.
- Observations (task-specific):
  - The opening-world autopay figure (7.290) equals the whole-baseline figure (7.290). An agent that skips both prerequisites and an agent that reads only the computation document land on the same wrong number. Not a defect: both differ from gold.
  - The persona's "pretty sure you switched carriers this fall" is correctly non-proof under base `equipment_insurance_requirement`. No persona line conflicts with the DB.
